title: The Witch of Atlas
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

authorInfo.bio: Percy Bysshe Shelley (1792–1822) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Witch of Atlas" by Percy Bysshe Shelley is a poem written in 1820 and published posthumously in 1824. In 78 ottava rima stanzas, it follows a mythical Witch who dwells in a cave on Atlas Mountain and creates a hermaphroditic companion.
